selectionReview.reason: All eight numbered questions required, with a choice between Q6A and Q6B. Both complete geometry alternatives are included; each retains 25 marks.
One of the things measured, one of the babies and one of the equal sloping sides identify context; none gives the candidate a menu of optional questions.

Q1 asks for an experiment and Q2(a) asks the candidate to construct three valid ordered-pair examples. The range 1–10 defines the experiment; it is not a printed pool of alternative prompts.
